Nigel Jemson scores the only goal of the game. 콜체스터 유나이티드 are relegated to the GM Vauxhall Conference after 40 years in the Football League , their demotion from the Fourth Division being confirmed by a 4–0 defeat to 케임브리지 유나이티드 at the Abbey Stadium , a result which keeps the home side's playoff hopes alive.

events.title: The month ends with 리버풀 confirmed as First Division champions, and 애스턴 빌라 sure of second place. 루턴 타운 trail 셰필드 웬즈데이 by three points with one game remaining in the fight to avoid the last relegation place. The Second Division promotion race is still wide open. 리즈 유나이티드 (top), 셰필드 유나이티드 (second) and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 (third) are fighting it out for automatic promotion. 스윈던 타운, 블랙번 로버스 and 선덜랜드 complete the top six, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 입스위치 타운 and 올덤 애슬레틱 still have a mathematical chance of breaking into the playoffs.

events.title: 셰필드 웬즈데이 are relegated on goal difference behind 루턴 타운, who win their final game of the season 3–2 at 더비 카운티 while the Hillsborough club lose 3–0 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트. 리버풀's season ends in style with a 6–1 away win over 코번트리 시티, and 토트넘 홋스퍼 pip 아스널 to third place by one point. 셰필드 유나이티드 seal promotion back to the First Division after 14 years away. Dave Bassett achieves the sixth promotion of his career with a Blades side who finished level on points with champions 리즈 유나이티드. 리즈 유나이티드's promotion celebrations are marred when their fans riot in 본머스 in the aftermath of the promotion clinching game against 본머스 , who were relegated by the result.
